_what: Numbers printed in the paper for the GEOM-Drugs experiment, transcribed verbatim. Nothing here is recomputed; the notebook puts these next to the values rebuilt from results/geom/.
_paper: dMFM (40).pdf, ICLR 2027 submission 'Scalable inference-time steering in molecular design with multimodal Meta Flow Maps'
_precision: Values the paper prints with a fixed number of decimals are stored as STRINGS holding the printed literal (thousands separators dropped so float() parses them). JSON numbers cannot carry trailing zeros -- 0.170 reads back as 0.17 -- and notebooks/_common.py compare() derives its tolerance from the decimal count, so a float would silently loosen it tenfold. Entries not fed to compare() (table19_geom_column, table20_geom_column, max_heavy_atoms) stay numeric.

table3.caption: GEOM-DRUGS structural fingerprint guidance. The two reference values are from TFG-Flow. multiMFM yielded 87.5% PB-valid structures, compared with 92.0% for its base generator.
table3._paper_lines: paper.txt 385-391 (Table 3, p.7); PB percentages in the caption
